textbook_results.title: Derm Mckee
textbook_results.excerpt: Pigment synthesising melanoma (animal-type melanoma, melanoma with prominent pigment synthesis, equine type melanoma, low-grade hypermelanotic dermal melanoma) is an exceedingly rare variant of melanoma. The relationship to malignant blue nevus is not clear but we believe that they represent independent histological entities. The original term of animal-type melanoma was coined to reflect the similarity of these tumors to melanocytic lesions occurring in horses and a variety of experimental animal models – so-called equine melanotic disease.1,2 This is a condition in which aging gray horses lose their pigmentation and develop melanocytic tumors particularly around the external genitalia, undersurface of tail, breast, and lip mucosa.
